title: Brand trust and loyalty references
summary: The topic centers on brand trust and loyalty language, but most fragments are too brief or context-poor to determine a clear sentiment about the brand.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention long-term affection for the brand and continued loyalty to it.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention trust, sticking with the brand, restoration of trust, a malfunctioning new car, and an unrelated Level 2 charger comment, but the brief excerpts do not support a clear sentiment classification for this topic.

limitations: Most sample fragments are very short and lack enough context to determine clear sentiment.
The cluster mixes brand-trust remarks with unrelated or weakly related content, including a Level 2 charger comment and a heat comparison statement.
With only one clearly positive example and no clearly coded negative, mixed, or neutral examples, the available evidence is insufficient for deeper aspect-level comparison.
